{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Impute missing revenue values for completed orders with 0
sales_df.loc[(sales_df['status'] == 'completed') & (sales_df['revenue'].isnull()), 'revenue'] = 0

# Check if the dataset contains a date column to define the campaign period
print("Columns in the dataset:")
print(sales_df.columns)
